_doc: Per-page metadata for the Category-26 (Peptides, SARMs, and Research Chemicals) standard renderer (tools/build-category-standard-pages.mjs). Numbers come from data/standards/cat26-compiled/<record>.json (deterministic; no authored values). Display + wiring + the category _meta block only.

_meta.methodology_version: Method v2.1 — ICH Q3D(R2) route-based elemental-impurity ceiling (Table A.2.2 Option-1 concentrations; oral vs parenteral)
method_prose: These products sit outside the food and dietary-supplement frameworks, but they are elemental-impurity-governed as pharmaceuticals. ICH Q3D(R2), harmonized across the US, EU, and Japan and enforceable through USP <232>-<233>, sets permitted daily exposures for elemental impurities in drug products and, in Table A.2.2, the corresponding route-based concentration limits (Option 1, for daily intakes of 10 grams or less). HMTc adopts those Table A.2.2 concentrations as the binding ceiling for this class, applied by route: oral products (SARMs, orally-dosed research chemicals) take the oral limits; injectable, nasal, and sublingual products take the stricter parenteral limits. Aluminium, which ICH Q3D does not address, is bound by the FDA large-volume-parenteral limit (21 CFR 201.323) on injectables.

Every analyte is measured on every lot by validated ICP-MS with reflex inorganic-arsenic speciation. Inorganic arsenic and methylmercury are bounded by their parent totals, and hexavalent chromium by total chromium (ICH Q3D governs chromium as the total element). Certification here is heavy-metal safety only: HMTc does not endorse, approve, or vouch for the efficacy or the legality of these products; the mark speaks solely to an elemental-impurity burden held within the ICH Q3D ceiling on the tested lot.

pages.name: Injectable peptide hormones (GLP-1 analogs, GH secretagogues, synthetic peptides)
pages.description: The Heavy Metal Tested & Certified heavy-metal-safety standard for Injectable peptide hormones (GLP-1 analogs, GH secretagogues, synthetic peptides) (Peptides, SARMs, and Research Chemicals), evaluated on the finished product as sold. Every analyte is held to the ICH Q3D(R2) elemental-impurity limit for the parenteral route (the harmonized pharmaceutical standard, enforceable via USP <232>), measured on every lot by ICP-MS. Certification is heavy-metal safety only and does not endorse the efficacy or legality of these products.
